ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast between high-intensity white ventral surface (~75% coverage) and low-intensity black pigmentation (~25% coverage) concentrated at the median notch and along the trailing edge border.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white fields occupying the majority of the lateral lobes. Dense, low-intensity black mottling cluster localized at the median notch vertex. Sparse, stochastic dark pixel speckling (diameter < 1% of lobe width) distributed across the light fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and serrated continuous boundary. Visible high-frequency pixel variations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge, with significant disruption at the distal tips due to external matter.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature fitted to both lobes, sweeping from the central notch to the lateral terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, irregular clusters of high-contrast pixel groups localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Scattered circular dark pixel clusters across the white surface areas.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of irregular, high-contrast calcified matter (barnacles) on the terminal edges of both fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark avian silhouette (bird) in the background plane, positioned above the right fluke lobe.
